summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets in equity securities of companies outside the United States in both developed and emerging markets countries, including non-U.S. dollar-denominated securities, or if market conditions are not favorable, at least 70% of its assets outside the United States, and hold securities of issuers located in at least three countries (not including the United States).
